intent: Make the gate and mutation sweep reliable evidence producers: content-sensitive tree stamps, strict non-empty selections, distinct partial records, attributable mutation kills, passing controls and verified restoration.
invariants: A full success record only describes all nine steps on one unchanged tree; partial and rerun evidence cannot replace it.
Unknown, absent and empty selectors fail before logs, caches or processes are touched; the gate never terminates a process it did not create.
A mutation kill requires a passing unmodified control, the intended tests to have run and an assertion failure attributable to the applied mutant.
Every mutation restores the exact pre-run bytes and modes in finally, even when execution fails; restoration and the final control are checked.
rollback: Revert both runners, their oracle and manifest as one batch. The previous committed full-gate record remains untouched by partial evidence.
notes: The EOS declaration-only router returned R1 for the declared sends-external effect, with no discrepancies. The operator proposed R2; this record voluntarily uses high-assurance R2 controls because runners certify all later batches. The actual diff is re-ruled upward at the gate. Existing T-0148 tests and four-outcome reporting remain binding.
